class.name: CSGSplitSettings
class.brief_description: Controls recursive plane splitting of a CSG result.
class.description: Configures [method CSGShape3D.split_meshes]. Every iteration attempts to split every current piece once, so the maximum unconstrained piece count is [code]2 ^ iterations[/code]. [member max_pieces] and [member min_piece_volume] prevent accidental creation of excessive or unusably small meshes.

members.member: Modifiers applied only to faces newly exposed by split planes. This can write a broken-surface marker into vertex colors or CUSTOM0 through CUSTOM3.
Scale of planar UV coordinates generated for newly exposed faces.
If [code]true[/code], disconnected solids are returned as separate meshes when this does not exceed [member max_pieces].
Recursive split depth in the range 0 through 10. A value of 3 can produce up to 8 pieces.
Hard upper bound for the number of generated pieces.
Rejects a split when either resulting side has a smaller volume.
Strategy used to choose split planes.
Maximum random offset from a piece center, expressed as a fraction of its projected half-extent.
Node type generated by the editor's [b]Create Split Meshes[/b] command. This does not change the return type of [method CSGShape3D.split_meshes].

Selects the local pivot of every generated part. Mesh vertices are made relative to this point, which is stored as [code]csg_split_center[/code] metadata on each returned [ArrayMesh]. The editor places the generated node at that point so its geometry remains in the original location.
Number of random planes attempted when a cut is empty or violates [member min_piece_volume].
Maximum randomization of the split-plane normal in radians.
Seed used by random splitting. Identical geometry, settings, and seed produce the same pieces.

constants.constant: Splits each piece through the center of its longest local bounding-box axis.
Randomizes the orientation and offset of each piece's split plane.
Keeps the source CSG node origin as the pivot for every part.
Uses the center of each part's axis-aligned bounding box.
Uses the center of the top Y face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the bottom Y face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the positive X face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the positive Y face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the positive Z face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the negative X face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the negative Y face of each part's bounding box.
Uses the center of the negative Z face of each part's bounding box.
Creates one [RigidBody3D] per generated part, with a mesh child and a single convex collision shape.
